# WF6: Dialect sweep

<!-- generated by python -m pfp_core.workflow_families.docs: do not edit -->
**What it is for:** Pose each seed item in k query-preserving dialects and grade every reply with one checker.

**Status:** runnable offline. The family runner checks its fixtures with no model call and no spend. No live or local model run of this runner is recorded yet. The pilots/ folder holds data from earlier model experiments run with an older harness; they are records, not runs of this runner.

**Run it offline** (no model call, no spend), from the repository root:

```powershell
python -m pfp_core.workflow_families run WF6
python -m pytest pfp_core/workflow_families/tests/test_families.py -q -k "WF6-"
```

**The check:** `dialect_query_preservation_sweep`. Only this check can certify; a model reply is evidence for it, never a verdict.

**Code:** [`pfp_core/workflow_families/layer4.py`](../../pfp_core/workflow_families/layer4.py) (`DialectSweep`) · [tests](../../pfp_core/workflow_families/tests/test_families.py) · [wiki page](https://github.com/dbccpage/proposal_fidelity_protocol_pfp/wiki/workflow_wf6)
<!-- end generated -->

**Kind:** experiment design. **Builds on:** [WF5](../wf05_checked_rewrite/README.md).

**Goal:** Measure, item by item, which presentation of the same task the host accepts more often, without changing the task.

## How it works

1. Freeze one seed and its host answer
2. Compile P* and k checked rewrites (dialects) of seed and P*
3. Dispatch each capsule once under the same model and parameters
4. Grade every reply with the same host checker
5. Report acceptance per dialect, item by item

## The check

Host check: family checker (e.g. exact linear algebra, graph facts, graph repair, typed refusal).

- `dialect family {rho_k}: decode(rho_k(s)) = q(s) for every k (preservation precondition)`
- `acceptance A_k = (1/N) sum_i 1[check(r_ik)] compared pairwise on the same items`
- `exact rational structure delta: Net = Delta_created - Delta_removed`

## Where it comes from

Sources: 0000000-0000019.

Pilots 0-10 retain 53-83 test capsules each (seed, P*, ten seed rewrites, ten P* rewrites); a few capsules hold manual live replies, most are offline controls.

## Team

Pattern `sweep_with_shared_judge`: coder ×1 (sonnet); coder ×1 (sonnet); deep_researcher ×1 (run_o); host_checker ×1 (none).

Boost: when a dialect fails preservation: run_o proposes a corrected rewrite from the preservation residual; recheck before any dispatch (limit 1).
